item.title: SenseTime Ships SenseNova U1 Pro Image Model With Up to 8K Output via Raccoon and API
item.description: SenseTime released the production SenseNova U1 Pro image-creation model through its Raccoon app and SenseNova API, citing interleaved text-image chain-of-thought generation and output resolution up to 8K with custom aspect ratios.

item.title: Alibaba Cloud Unveils Qwen Book AI Agent PC: Skill Keyboard, AI Island Display and Omarchy OS Collab
item.description: Alibaba Cloud debuted Qwen Book, its first AI agent PC, at Apsara 2026 with a Skill keyboard array, AI Island status display and an Omarchy open-source desktop OS collaboration, opening a Day One tester program toward December trials.

item.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen Intelligence Phone-Agent Stack; Honor Magic9 Named First Formal Adopter
item.description: At Apsara 2026, Alibaba released Qwen Intelligence, a modular phone-agent platform spanning Mobile Planner, Mobile-Use and Creative agents plus an OS Harness, with Honor's forthcoming Magic9 series as the first formal adopter.

item.title: Xiaomi Details HySparse2 for MiMo-V3: Two-Level KV Sharing Cuts 1M-Token Prefill FLOPs About 5× vs Hybrid SWA
item.description: Xiaomi's LLM-Core team published HySparse2, a hybrid sparse-attention design with two-level KV sharing aimed at MiMo-V3-class agentic models, reporting about 5× lower 1M-token prefill FLOPs versus Hybrid SWA on an 80B-A3B MoE.

item.title: Huawei Debuts OceanStor M900 Context Memory Storage: PB-Scale Shared KV Cache With ~60μs NPU-to-SSD Hop
item.description: At HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, Huawei introduced OceanStor M900 Context Memory Storage for SuperPoDs, claiming a PB-scale shared KV-cache pool, one-hop NPU-to-SSD access near 60 microseconds, and up to 40 TB/s aggregate cluster bandwidth.
